delivery_methodology: The project will be executed using an AI-enabled agile approach characterized by short, time-boxed iterations with regular demonstrations and continuous client feedback. This iterative process ensures that the solution evolves in alignment with Kalinaw Trading Corporation's needs and allows for timely adjustments.

AI tools assist by drafting documentation, code snippets, and test cases, which are then reviewed, refined, and approved by the project team. This collaboration between AI and human experts enhances productivity while maintaining quality and control. Scope changes are managed carefully to preserve project focus and delivery timelines.
executive_summary: Kalinaw Trading Corporation seeks to implement a comprehensive Human Resource Information System (HRIS) to streamline employee data management, automate leave and attendance processes, and provide timely workforce insights. This initiative is critical to enhancing operational efficiency and supporting informed decision-making across all branches and departments.

Exist Software Labs proposes a tailored HRIS solution that integrates employee information management, time and attendance tracking, self-service capabilities, and robust reporting. Delivered through a cloud-deployed microservices architecture, the system will be developed using Java, Spring Boot, React, and PostgreSQL, ensuring scalability and reliability. Upon completion, Kalinaw Trading Corporation will have a unified, accurate, and accessible platform that meets their HR operational needs.
proposed_solution: The proposed HRIS solution consolidates key HR functions into a single platform accessible to employees, HR staff, and management. It enables comprehensive employee record management, leave and attendance processing, and self-service features such as leave applications and payslip viewing. Management benefits from dashboards and reports that provide insights into workforce metrics like headcount, attrition, and attendance trends.

This solution aligns with Kalinaw Trading Corporation's operational workflows by automating manual processes, ensuring data accuracy, and facilitating timely approvals and notifications. The system supports role-based access control to maintain security and compliance, while integration with the payroll system ensures seamless data exchange for payroll processing.
technical_architecture: The HRIS is designed as a cloud-deployed microservices architecture leveraging Java and Spring Boot for backend services, React for the frontend interface, and PostgreSQL as the primary data store. This layered architecture separates concerns across presentation, business logic, and data persistence, promoting maintainability and scalability.

Integration with external systems, such as payroll, is handled through secure APIs, ensuring reliable data exchange and reconciliation. The system supports multiple environments for development, testing, and production, with built-in mechanisms for performance optimization and security, including role-based access control and audit trails. This architecture effectively supports the requirement for high availability and concurrent user support.
warranty_support: The solution includes a warranty period during which any defects or issues identified will be promptly addressed and corrected at no additional cost. Defects can be reported through a defined process, ensuring clear communication and timely resolution.

The warranty covers all functionalities delivered as part of the project scope, excluding issues arising from unauthorized modifications or external factors. Post-warranty support and maintenance services are available as separate options to ensure ongoing system reliability and performance.
